name: Munaciello
body:
Munaciello
CR 2

A spectral apparition of a lean, emaciated child with sunken eyes, wearing a tattered friar’s robe, flashes for a moment before your eyes. You manage to catch a faint smile on its face before it vanishes again.

XP 600
CN Small undead (incorporeal)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)
hp 19 (3d8+6)
Fort +3, Ref +3, Will +5
Defensive Abilities channel resistance +4, incorporeal; Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed fly 30 ft. (perfect)
Melee jinx touch +3 (DC 13)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 3rd; concentration +5)

At will—invisibility (self only)

Bard Spells Known (CL 3rd; concentration +5)

1st (4/day)—beguiling gift (DC 13), fool’s gold (DC 14), hideous laughter (DC 13), lucky numberom
0th (at will)—dancing lights, ghost sound (DC 13), mage hand, mending, prestidigitation (DC 12), open/close

STATISTICS

Str —, Dex 14, Con —, Int 13, Wis 14, Cha 15
Base Atk +2; CMB +1; CMD 13
Feats Dodge, Spell Focus (illusion)
Skills Fly +12, Intimidate +8, Knowledge (religion) +7, Perception +8, Sense Motive +8, Stealth +8
Languages Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Jinx Touch (Su)

By passing part of its incorporeal body through a creature’s body as a standard action, a munaciello causes the target to suffer the effects of an evil eye hex, as if used by a 3rd-level witch. The saving throw is Charisma-based.

La Smorfia (Sp)

If a munaciello takes a liking to the residents of “its” home, it can leave puzzles and cryptic messages for them that can be interpreted using the 1-to-90 numeric divination system known as La Smorfia. The right numbers to associate to the puzzle can be calculated by succeeding at a DC 25 Knowledge (arcana) or DC 20 Intelligence check. Only one creature can try to interpret each puzzle left by the munaciello; the message then disappears. By interpreting the signs correctly, a creature gains the benefits of a divination spell with 90% effectiveness.

Spellcasting

A munaciello casts spells as a 3rd-level bard.

ECOLOGY

Environment any urban
Organization solitary
Treasure double

A munaciello is a non-evil ghost variant that haunts homes where families live, playing pranks but also leaving small signs of its favor. It appears as a spectral apparition of a lean, emaciated child with sunken eyes, wearing a tattered friar’s robe, flashes for a moment before your eyes. You manage to catch a faint smile on its face before it vanishes again.

There’s always only one munaciello in a house. It can be an unlucky presence, causing small items to be lost, clothes to unstitch, food and milk to go bad. If its death came at the beginning of adolescence, leaving it the regret of not having known love, it can vent its frustration by touching young women in improper ways; younger munacielli may only desire to play and will manifest as spectral laughter in dark rooms and sudden voices calling the family’s children in the middle of the night. A family sometimes is forced to have the spirit exorcized, but this could attract bad luck too.

A benevolent munaciello that is respected and properly honored (by playing together with it and giving it attention and familiar care) can bring good luck to a family, for example leaving gold coins and other precious items in a coat’s pockets or in some forgotten corner of the house, so it’s always advisable to address it politely and grant its requests. A satisfied munaciello can even guide someone to a hidden treasure or give them the right numbers to win the lottery. Boasting about a newfound wealth, however, **is likely to earn the spirit’s ire, causing it to abandon the household and seek ways to bring misfortune upon them in turn.

A munaciello is said to be the ghost of a child dead by disease; in old times, parents dressed weak and ill children as monks, consecrating them to Heaven in exchange for recovery. That’s why a munaciello wears monastic robes, even in death (“munaciello” means “little monk”). Mostly, this spirit is retained in the world of the living by a regret of its unfulfilled childhood or a desire of revenge for being bullied by adults or other children when it was alive.
